set.body:
Scope:
Apply the low-risk review cleanup after the NIfTI reader and workflow-policy edits settle, avoiding overlapping changes in the same files.

Changes:
- Replace manual compressed-staging stream closure with Using.Manager or equivalent reverse-order closure that closes every acquired resource and preserves suppressed failures.
- Keep atomic staging and no-partial-finalized-artifact behavior.
- Replace opaque-type asInstanceOf coercions with explicit opaque-type ascriptions.
- Replace compileUnit's guarded Option.get calls with exhaustive local matching.
- Convert new Double and matrix assertions to explicit tolerance-based helpers.
- Add EmptyCatalog preflight coverage.
- Remove the currently unreachable OutputCollision preflight branch, or first introduce a validated configurable output mapping that makes collision possible and test it.
- Remove the unused direct fmri-workflow -> pipeline dependency and align README/module-relations; restore the edge only when the existing orchestration item implements real lowering.

Acceptance:
- Failure during stream acquisition, transfer, or close cannot leak an already-acquired stream or leave a finalized partial cache artifact.
- No asInstanceOf remains in WorkflowTypes and no Option.get remains in BidsStudyCompiler.compileUnit.
- New dataset/workflow floating assertions use explicit tolerances.
- Every retained preflight code is reachable through a public validated construction path and has a test.
- Source imports prove pipeline is not used before lowering; build.sbt and module documentation agree.
- datasetJVM/test, datasetJS/test, fmriWorkflowJVM/test, and fmriWorkflowJS/test pass warning-clean apart from documented third-party runtime notices.
set.title: Workflow foundation: harden resources, types, tests, and module edges
